tagline: Derma Radiant SPF 50 Sunscreen Gel – Advanced Broad-Spectrum Protection
intro: Protect your skin every day with Derma Radiant SPF 50 Sunscreen Gel, a lightweight, fast-absorbing formula designed to shield your skin from harmful UVA, UVB, and IR rays. Crafted for all skin types, this non-greasy gel provides powerful sun protection without clogging pores or leaving a white cast.

p: Its refreshing gel-based formula keeps your skin protected, hydrated, and comfortable throughout the day—perfect for daily wear under makeup or on its own.
How to Use:Apply generously to face and exposed areas 15–20 minutes before sun exposure. Reapply every 2–3 hours for optimal protection.
li: Helps prevent sun damage, tanning & premature aging

full: Derma Radiant SPF 50 Sunscreen Gel – Advanced Broad-Spectrum Protection
